name: agents-library
description: Orchestrator skills for defining, planning, building, verifying, reviewing and shipping work, UX-psychology review, issue filing, batch merging, and a manager console that delegates work items to worker agents.

interface.shortDescription: Define, plan, build, verify, review, and ship skills.
interface.longDescription: Agents Library provides Codex skills for defining a request as problem, scope and done-criteria; planning it into small verifiable tasks; building them test first; verifying each acceptance criterion end to end; reviewing a branch across seven quality domains and reviewing UX psychology; shipping the result as a pull request, a push, or a commit; filing new issues from a description; batch-merging pull requests; and turning a session into a manager console that delegates each work item to worker agents — one coordinator per item, a team sized to its complexity, and a plan, review, build, review, and test loop — and tracks them on a status board without doing the work itself.
defaultPrompt: Define this request before we plan it.
Plan a feature before we build it.
Ship this branch as a pull request.
